name: mobile-dotnet-maui
description: Use when the user asks about .NET MAUI apps, MAUI Shell navigation, MVVM with CommunityToolkit, data binding, CollectionView, handlers or migrating from Xamarin.Forms. Produces cross-platform C#/XAML app structure, platform code and release setup. Not for C# language features (use lang-csharp) or ASP.NET Core services (use dotnet-architecture).
